gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-ibm-plex-sans: Bruno Ace SC spreads its wide-open letters out like beads on a long thread, a heading with real swagger. And IBM Plex Sans follows with generous room inside every bowl, so extended text feels approachable and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab reads sturdy and technical, with a broad opening on every curve that ends in a bowl. Bruno Ace SC sits over it with every stroke measured to one thickness, giving the page a crisp, engineered edge.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-clash-grotesk: Chunky and confident, Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe and gives diagonals the same heft as verticals. Clash Grotesk then brings plain sans simplicity, with no thick-and-thin shifts, and that stripped-back quality is what makes the pairing work.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-alpino: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe and keeps a constant pen pressure through every diagonal and vertical. Alpino is the cozy, casual one, tall and tightly spaced.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk is lively and fairly neutral, with tall lowercase and bowls left unfinished on one side. Over a longer passage, Familjen Grotesk keeps moving along, a loose, brisk counterpoint to the commanding Cherry Swash heading.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-hind: Cherry Swash opens its c like a horseshoe and carries a commanding look. Its heavy diagonals earn their keep when set big and short, while Hind stays quietly in the background with lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-nunito: Flat-weighted and bold, Cherry Swash opens its c like a horseshoe. Nunito sits next to it feeling soft and contemporary, its big round bowls and terminals clear of the stem easing off the heading's firm hand.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded reads warm, with big counters and curves that refuse to close. Next to Cherry Swash, with its commanding horseshoe c, it feels like a gentle voice answering a loud one.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-akatab: Akatab reads approachable, its round letters looking cupped rather than clenched. Across a longer passage, Akatab stays unfussy and easy to settle into, while Cherry Swash holds the heading with its horseshoe c and unshaded strokes.
